description: Na₂Gd₄NOCl₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.83-2.99 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.01 Å. There are four inequivalent Gd sites. In the first Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and seven Cl atoms. The Gd-N bond length is 2.27 Å. The Gd-O bond length is 2.24 Å. There are a spread of Gd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.34 Å. In the second Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and seven Cl atoms. The Gd-N bond length is 2.20 Å. The Gd-O bond length is 2.33 Å. There are a spread of Gd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.33 Å. In the third Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and six Cl atoms. The Gd-N bond length is 2.25 Å. The Gd-O bond length is 2.30 Å. There are a spread of Gd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.75-3.14 Å. In the fourth Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and six Cl atoms. The Gd-N bond length is 2.26 Å. The Gd-O bond length is 2.32 Å. There are a spread of Gd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.05 Å. N is bonded to four Gd atoms to form NGd₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent OGd₄ tetrahedra. O is bonded to four Gd atoms to form OGd₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent NGd₄ tetrahedra. There are nine inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Gd atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Gd atoms. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Gd atoms. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Gd atoms. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Gd atoms. In the sixth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Gd atoms. In the seventh Cl site, Cl is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Gd atoms. In the eighth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na and four Gd atoms. In the ninth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na and four Gd atoms.
